sample_unit: vignette evaluations (20 vignettes with gender and race permutations)

links.outcome: Change in LLM treatment rankings when vignette gender or race was permuted
links.effect: Results were not meaningfully different when gender or race of the vignette was permuted to examine risk for bias; optimal choice prioritized in 114/320 vignettes (35.6%).
links.quote: Results were not meaningfully different when gender or race of the vignette was permuted to examine risk for bias.

links.outcome: Agreement of guideline-augmented LLM with expert-ranked optimal treatment
links.effect: Augmented model prioritized expert-designated optimal choice for 114/320 vignettes (35.6%, 95% CI 30.6%-41.0%; kappa 0.34); no contraindicated treatments chosen. No unaugmented comparison reported.
links.quote: The augmented model prioritized the expert-designated optimal choice for 114/320 vignettes (35.6 %, 95 % CI 30.6 %-41.0 %; Cohen's kappa = 0.34, 95 % CI 0.28-0.39).

unlisted_practices: Augmenting a small locally run LLM with a synopsis of published treatment guidelines for psychopharmacology decision support

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM augmented with treatment guidelines on clinical vignettes of treatment-resistant depression compared to expert and community clinicians, but does not test a deployment practice comparatively.
